fact_text: Foodpanda said a LUMS-conducted study put the platform's economic impact in 2023-24 at about USD 1.2 billion, counting jobs, taxes, restaurant business and rider livelihoods.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it has more than 10,000 riders, and that multiplying them by household size gives a large business impact on their families.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said 53% of its riders reported higher income since joining the platform, according to the study's findings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda's home-chef ecosystem lets women work from home, and the company said home chefs can earn up to 12,000 per month; the currency was not stated.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The logistics head said riders are the company's backbone: the company exists because of them, and riders are treated as onboard members rather than a commodity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it insures riders against theft, mobile snatching during shifts and road accidents, and gives full coverage for accidents on the road.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it offers riders financing facilities and perks, including an Umrah trip for a batch of riders, to make their work easier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda runs an optimised logistics model that aims to keep riders busy, so riders who are idle during the day get more orders and can maximise their earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Rain, extreme weather and internet outages are external factors beyond Foodpanda's control that stop deliveries and cut riders' earnings, which the company is working to reduce.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it is exploring Wi-Fi models, including Wi-Fi shared from restaurants and Wi-Fi installed at its rider hubs in Pandamarts, to reduce the effect of outages on rider income.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda's business spans food delivery, grocery delivery through its Pandamart service, and a home-chef ecosystem that lets women work from home.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The company said grocery and quick-commerce demand will keep rising as customers, especially young people, order groceries and drinks online instead of going out.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it plans to expand its grocery range into more cities, naming Gujranwala, Sialkot and Hyderabad, and to open new areas within Lahore and Karachi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda's expansion decisions are data-driven: it maps customer availability in an area before deciding to enter a city or open a new area.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The company said platform growth starts with customers, which passes revenue to restaurants and then income to riders, so adding vendors lifts both customer numbers and rider earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it has made significant investment in Pakistan and will keep investing in local infrastructure, customers and marketing, as its group sees potential in the market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said it has distributed electric bikes to around 15 to 20 riders and has run pilots with 12 to 13 companies in which riders tested electric bikes.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda said the main challenges for riders switching to electric bikes are charging facilities and the repair and maintenance infrastructure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The logistics head said Pakistan will take some time to adopt electric motorcycles, and that talks with government on subsidised financing or subsidised bikes for riders are under way.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Foodpanda's delivery fleet runs mainly on 70cc motorcycles, and planning electric alternatives for these bikes is part of the company's EV work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Pakistan's young, growing population and rising smartphone and internet penetration are cited as the base for gig-economy growth, since the work needs only a smartphone and a bike, not a degree.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The reporter noted that Punjab's government is focused on replacing motorcycles with green energy and electric bikes, and that Sindh's government is also moving toward EVs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Head of Logistics Ahsan Malik on How Foodpanda Riders Shape Pakistan's Economy | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)
